verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents interact with the Stripe API, which enables natural-language operation of Billing functions through an LLM/agent interface rather than manual API calls or dashboard clicks. However, there is no first-party or community evidence of a dedicated conversational/chat interface for end-users, nor hands-on proof that natural-language commands reliably map to billing actions. Missing for 10: concrete examples of natural-language commands executing billing operations, independent/hands-on validation of the MCP server's NL capabilities, and any built-in chat-style interface beyond MCP.
